metadata.description: Curated Copilot plugins for enterprise C# development, Coalesce framework, and Vue 3 with Vuetify. Designed to support SOLID principles, best practices, and architectural excellence.

plugins.name: coalesce-accelerator

plugins.name: vuetify-components

plugins.name: enterprise-bug-fixing
